shaders.name: Shaders: What a Surface Answers To
shaders.truth: A familiar form can be evaluated as a surface rule. Coordinates, material, light and viewpoint affect its appearance; mesh geometry, collision and retained state remain distinct constructions.
shaders.qfep_connection: Earlier coordinates, forms, arrays and fields return as choices inside a material. The learner locates where each choice changes an appearance, a body or a record. Re-evaluating from coordinates and a clock differs from updating from retained state; the final hall makes that missing connection explicit before Cellular Automata.
shaders.formula: surface sample → form rule → material response; retained state requires a connected input
shaders.description: Six existing halls move from wall images to staged bodies and rooms: graph functions, coordinate patterns, material responses on primitives, layered fields and a glass-covered basin, pink compositions, then a panel whose previous-state input is missing. The proposed tutorial carries a small form rule through these encounters, drawing on earlier sequences and The Book of Shaders.
learning_objectives: Reuse point distance and colour mapping to construct a mask, keeping its visible boundary distinct from the panel mesh
Transform a sampling coordinate and separate tile address from local position to vary one repeated form
Compare one material on different primitive bodies and distinguish normal/view response from received light
Use a finite layered field to change appearance while identifying the separate construction that supports the visitor
Compose known material operations and explain an alternate appearance without adding a compulsory new technique
Distinguish clock-driven re-evaluation from retained-state feedback and identify the missing previous input before Cellular Automata
content: Shader_01_Shaping: existing graph panels; proposed return to point, distance and boundary as a small surface mask
Shader_05_Patterns: existing coordinate tilings and world-projected garden; proposed transforms and address-selected variation of the retained form
Shader_11_QueerRubber: existing staged primitive bodies; proposed comparison of a shared material and its view-dependent rim
Shader_09_FBM: existing layered fields and basin under glass; proposed finite field applied to the retained form
Shader_12_PinkExtravaganza: existing pink materials and plural body; proposed composition with known operations and a declared receiver
Shader_10_ReactionDiffusion: previous-state texture is unbound and frost retains no growth; reflective handoff to Cellular Automata

deferred_reason.Shader_02_Colors: colour is sequence four’s; the hall stays on disk for the pattern-generation walk
deferred_reason.Shader_03_Shapes: Reuse selected mask functions inside Shaping; keep the full gallery deferred.
deferred_reason.Shader_04_Matrices: Return to earlier transforms through sampling coordinates inside Patterns; keep the full gallery deferred.
deferred_reason.Shader_07_Noise: noise is sequence eleven’s; FBM carries the field here
deferred_reason.Shader_08_CellularNoise: Voronoi appears inside the patterns hall
deferred_reason.Shader_Arch_Gallery: a 65-row gallery, not a hall of the walk

local_review_history.note: Sequence created on Palle’s word: a shader sequence introduced with the architecture of liminal spaces (pillar hallways, passages, basins). Assembled from the Book of Shaders halls of the non-spine pattern-generation sequence; museum blocks added; basin_water built for the basin hall.

Palle: 'the first examples can go as images on the walls I think and then stages large spheres and cubes then spaces'. Reordered: images (01 shaping, 05 patterns) -> bodies on stages (11) -> spaces (09 basin, 12 pink) -> the seam (10). The picture racks of 01 and 05 stand against the north wall; 11 and 12 take scale/shapes/stage tokens.

local_review_history.decision: Keep six halls and images → bodies → rooms. Carry a familiar form through masks, transforms, repetition, materials and fields. Read The Book of Shaders as a reference, adapting explicitly to Godot.
local_review_history.status: Teaching proposal updated; museum logic, map order and full manuscripts unchanged.
